title: Spyglass Has Arrived!
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering powerful new insights and capabilities to elevate your experience.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Take full control of your content with powerful new tools to easily upload, manage, and customize the visual display of your files directly within the editor.

title: Explore Our Product Roadmap
summary: Gain transparent insight into our latest releases, upcoming features, and long-term vision with our brand new product roadmap.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, integrating them seamlessly into your workflow for a more intuitive and visually cohesive experience.

title: Enhanced Collaboration for Effortless Teamwork
summary: Elevate your team's productivity with our enhanced editor, now offering seamless real-time collaboration and intuitive syncing for an effortless shared experience.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Discovering and collaborating on shared content is now simpler than ever, ensuring you always find the right information when you need it.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out robust support for international languages, making our platform truly global.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, inviting our community to gain unprecedented control, transparency, and direct involvement in shaping the future of the project.

title: Intelligent Constellation View: Discover and Organize
summary: Experience a powerful new Constellation view that lets you filter your knowledge, uncover connections, and effortlessly start new workflows.

title: Smart Search & Curated Collections
summary: Experience a powerful new search that allows you to precisely filter and sort your knowledge, then save these refined views as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Adaptive Note Views
summary: Discover a revolutionary approach to note organization with adaptive views that seamlessly align with your individual thought processes.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Experience ultimate control and unlock premium features with Noeko's new self-hosting option and flexible paid plans, designed to scale with your needs.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Our Vibrant New Theme Collection
summary: Get ready for a visual upgrade as we refine existing themes and launch a diverse collection of stunning new designs to suit every preference.

title: Dynamic Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We are improving our greetings to always accurately reflect the current time of day, ensuring a perfectly personalized welcome every time you log in.

title: Instant Actions for Your Tagged Items
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your tagged content by performing essential actions like unapplying tags directly from your list views, making organization faster and more intuitive than ever.

title: Unlock Your Full Knowledge: Diverse Source Integration
summary: Expand your research and learning by effortlessly integrating content from YouTube videos, websites, text files, and pasted text directly into your workflow, making every piece of information actionable.
